Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Valley Produce operates as a retail market specializing in the sale of fresh fruits and vegetables. We source our products from local farms and wholesalers to ensure quality and sustainability. Our operations include daily inventory management, customer service, and maintaining a safe and clean shopping environment. We also offer seasonal promotions and community events to engage our customers and promote healthy eating. Our location features a mix of indoor and outdoor displays, and we prioritize the health and safety of our customers and employees. Additionally, we comply with all relevant food safety regulations and maintain necessary licenses for the sale of perishable goods.
